note: Weekly target = August monthly GA4 target x 7/30. Vesu remains excluded (still closed, no bookings or Google spend). Hong Kong had its strongest week of the half: 1,041 bookings against a 949 target (+9.7 percent), up +9.1 percent week on week and +14.6 percent year on year. Four venues beat target, led by Cantina (+83%), The Chinese Library (+28%), Shiro (+24%) and Hutong (+12%). Dim Sum Library (-18%) and Aqua HK (-4%) were the only misses, and both are the same two venues still behind on YTD (Aqua HK -6.8%, Dim Sum Library -6.9%); the other four are all double-digit percentages ahead. The portfolio is now +6.1 percent ahead of its cumulative YTD target.
